how_to_read: entities: new entities in the strokes format, ready to copy into a part (as S4's merge_fixes accept()). retire: entities to drop in merge_fixes.mjs, with the reason. changes: edits to existing entities; 'set' keys are fields or 'pts.<name>' points, 'remove_pts' drops points, 'add_note' is text to append to the note. checked: the merge's list for this half, read again, with no change proposed. Porter in a short jacket and a dark cap, bent forward under a carrying pole across his shoulders with a round basket hung on cords at each end, one hand raised to steady the pole in front of his face, stepping east down the gangplank from the bank toward the mat-cargo boat.

changes.add_note: Second pass: facing changed from 180 to 330 (conf med).
